bounded_read_only_review.translation_callbacks: handleBlocksTranslated changes displayBlocks/paginatedBlocks, not useChapterContent.blocks. Therefore displayBlocksSource===blocks stays true for ordinary stream results and does not reset the generation on every result.
bounded_read_only_review.refresh: A newly accepted content array temporarily gates translation until displayBlocks is merged from that same source. The display-sync effect reaches a stable dependency set; no fetch is triggered by that effect. The visible loading gate does not include this array comparison.
bounded_read_only_review.ready_text: Same book/chapter/language merges preserve prior ready target text when the refreshed block has only fallback; enqueueBlock independently skips targetLangReady blocks. The existing mergeDisplayBlocks tests and actual hook partial-success test cover those boundaries.
bounded_read_only_review.account_language: Generation changes synchronously during render for account/book/chapter/language/canTranslate changes. Late callbacks and finally handlers require both generation and request ownership. The Reader route masks the previous metadata identity on account/share changes. Different-language merges disable text preservation.
bounded_read_only_review.bounded_cost: A same-chapter content refresh can abort/restart unfinished work once when the snapshot is rebound; already ready IDs are skipped. Three recovery retries/30s cooldown, 60s stream deadline, 10s status deadline and 120s recovery window remain in force.
bounded_read_only_review.manual_refresh: Context object identity scopes busy/completion handling, including A→B→A and unmount. The two integrated actual-queue UI cases hold the IDB write until the new source has committed, then verify exactly one retry for either the same or replacement missing ID.

limitations: All transport/cache effects in the harness are synthetic; no real LLM or production DB is called.
Reader UI fixtures omit production CSS and use simplified pagination rectangles; semantic button dispatch does not verify pixel hit testing.
Candidate was uncommitted when recorded; source hashes bind the tested files. Final build/release provenance is owned by root.

followup_duplicate_stream.disposition: New regression reproduced; production rollout paused by root; minimal fix written and focused checks passed. Final build/release remains root-owned.
